figurative_meaning_en: To marry an unsuitable or unworthy person
similar_in_english: Cast pearls before swine (in a marital context)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অপাত্রের সাথে বিয়ে করে জলে পড়েছে।
মেয়েটিকে এমন ছেলের সাথে বিয়ে দিলে জলে পড়বে।
example_sentences_in_english: She married an unworthy man and has fallen into the water.
If you marry the girl off to such a guy, she'll fall into the water.
note: This idiom reflects traditional concerns in Bengali society about suitable marital alliances, often used in rural contexts to express regret over mismatched marriages.
